title: knowgov reader store_status
description: What the MCP reader's store_status returns (harness/mcp_server.py Tools.store_status; task-0172): the subject, the store kind, the scenario the store holds for this subject (null when none, or when it holds another subject's, which held_by_other_subject names), when it was loaded, the date gate_verdict and evidence_bundle read on by default and where it came from, the subject's scenarios, its task classes with their required keys, block levels, bar and rationale, and the keys the three-valued question is asked of; and knowgov, which knowgov the server runs.

require_approved.description: present when the class requires approved for its keys (task-0215)

tasks.description: task class name to its spec

knowgov.description: Which knowgov this server runs, read once at start from its own files (harness/build_identity.py, as the page's /api/subjects): VERSION, the full commit, and git describe's tag-n-g<sha> when it names a tag and agrees with the commit; each null when unknown, never guessed.
